scope: Isolated audited query evaluator and SQL lowering on macOS ARM64, DuckDB 2.0.0 Node SDK
coverage: Actual Triplex tag-5 references and tag-6 datetime compatibility rows in format five
Bounded native and scalable SQL exact datetime bits, comparison, extrema and reference cast joins
Wrong reference tags, empty product, uncast distinctness and stable four-tag raw wire behavior
Both controlled v2 templates reject an invalidated live owner generation and work after revalidation
Audited simple comparison scans preserve comparison, admission, bounded native, cached cut and cancellation semantics
limitations: Temporary local schema switch cases rejected expanded schema writes for this isolated build.
Expanded schema registration, format activation, typed mutation and default SDK v2 dispatch were not present in this artifact.
